item.title: Lacy 2.0 (build 6)
item.description:
The notch becomes a pill.

After this update macOS asks for Lacy's permissions one more time (Calendar, Camera and the like). From now on it remembers them across updates.

  • A new pill grows out of the notch: black while it's small, Liquid Glass when it opens
  • Two things at once: when a timer and music are both on, one holds the pill and the other waits in a small bubble beside it
  • Pomodoro: 25 minutes of focus, then a 5-minute break, with a longer break every fourth round
  • Floating timer: drag the timer anywhere, or dock it to the edge of the screen
  • Pill Studio: choose what the open pill is made of, its tint and size, and what sits beside the notch
  • Presets: Minimal, Music, Deep Work or Maximal in one click, or save your own look and share it as a file
  • Extensions: turn each part of Lacy on or off in one place, from Now Playing to Snake
  • Important alerts are never cut off: a low battery or a meeting reminder stays up, and smaller notes wait their turn
  • A new player: controls that light up under the pointer, the playing app's icon on the cover, and a favourite star for Apple Music
  • Snake gets nine levels, five mazes and a bonus ladybird
  • A big mirror in the middle of the screen, from Tools
  • Ask shows your assistant's own logo, and Calendar lists every event of the day
  • Clearer text on the glass, even over bright pages
  • Fixes: the right player stays up when a paused app grabs Now Playing, the shelf only opens when a file reaches the notch, and VoiceOver names every button

item.title: Lacy 1.1.1 (build 5)
item.description:
Small fixes, and the way to Lacy 2.

  • The right player stays up when a paused app grabs Now Playing, and the position is correct when you resume
  • The shelf only opens when a file reaches the notch, and you can turn that off in Settings
  • VoiceOver names every button, Reduce Motion stills the lock screen colours, and Reduce Transparency gets solid glass
  • On a MacBook with a notch, Lacy 2 will be offered as the next update

item.title: Lacy 1.1 (build 4)
item.description:
The lock screen gets a full-screen player.

  • Tap the artwork on the lock screen to open a full-screen player: a big, sharp cover on its own flowing colours
  • Time-synced lyrics in the full-screen player, off by default (Settings → Lock Screen, from LRCLIB)
  • Space plays and pauses, ← and → skip, right on the lock screen
  • Pick where the sound goes from the lock screen
  • Sharper covers for music and YouTube
  • The playing app's icon sits in the lock screen card, with the title and artist centred

item.title: Lacy 1.0 (build 3)
item.description:
Your Mac's notch, alive. The first full release.

  • Now Playing for any app, browsers included: artwork, progress, controls, and a click on the title jumps to the tab or app that's playing
  • Lock screen: a see-through glass Now Playing card while your Mac is locked, and an unlock confirmation in the notch
  • Calendar: today's events at a glance; tap any day or flip months
  • Shelf for files, Ask (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), Snake, and Tools: timer, Keep Awake, clipboard history, color picker, mirror, note
  • Battery, Bluetooth, Focus, volume and brightness, shown in the notch
  • Stays out of the way: hidden in full screen until you point at it
  • Automatic updates

item.title: Lacy 0.9.0 (build 2)
item.description:
First public beta build with automatic updates.

  • Calendar: tap any day to see its events, flip months, jump back to today
  • Player: artwork sits beside the title; click the title to jump to the app or browser tab that's playing
  • Full screen: point at the notch to open it
  • Clipboard history is kept across restarts and scrolls with the trackpad
  • Mirror uses the built-in camera reliably
  • Ask: Gemini replaces Google AI
  • Runs on Intel Macs too
